title: Evaluation, Fairness, and Decision Support
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of calibration, subgroup checks, missing data, and human oversight, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in loan-default-prediction.
learning_objectives: Explain calibration, subgroup checks, missing data, and human oversight in plain language and connect it to models.py; tools/lr_clf.py.
Trace one input through the evaluation, fairness, and decision support stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: calibration, subgroup checks, missing data, and human oversight
practical_outcomes: Trace the evaluation, fairness, and decision support stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for calibration, subgroup checks, missing data, and human oversight.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
